arxiv-2012-07079.title: CHS-Net: A Deep learning approach for hierarchical segmentation of COVID-19 via CT images
arxiv-2012-07079.creator: Narinder Singh Punn*, Sonali Agarwal
arxiv-2012-07079.description: Abstract The pandemic of novel severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) also known as COVID-19 has been spreading worldwide, causing rampant loss of lives. Medical imaging such as computed tomography (CT), X-ray, etc., plays a significant role in diagnosing the patients by presenting the visual representation of the functioning of the organs.

arxiv-2110-09412.title: Very-High-Energy Emission From Pulsars
arxiv-2110-09412.creator: Alice K. Harding, Christo Venter, Constantinos Kalapotharakos
arxiv-2110-09412.description: Abstract Air-Cherenkov telescopes have detected pulsations at energies above 50 GeV from a growing number of Fermi pulsars. These include the Crab, Vela, PSR B1706 − - 44 and Geminga, with the first two having pulsed detections above 1 TeV.

arxiv-2506-09321.title: Ultra-lightweight multi-functional gyroid-based metamaterial for simultaneous sound insulation, vibration suppression, and impact mitigation in all directions
arxiv-2506-09321.creator: Evan Kluge, Osama R. Bilal
arxiv-2506-09321.description: Abstract Multi-functional materials are increasingly essential in many applications due to their ability to serve multiple purposes, simultaneously. Metamaterials can offer tailored functionality based on carefully designed tessellating basic building blocks, or unit cells, in space. These unit cells are most commonly designed for a single objective, for example, to mitigate an impact, insulate sound, or dampen vibrations.

pmc-10784791.title: Establishment of models to predict factors influencing periodontitis in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
pmc-10784791.creator: Hong-Miao Xu, Xuan-Jiang Shen, Jia Liu
pmc-10784791.description: BACKGROUNDType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is associated with periodontitis. Currently, there are few studies proposing predictive models for periodontitis in patients with T2DM.AIMTo determine the factors influencing periodontitis in patients with T2DM by constructing logistic regression and random forest models.

pmc-11645541.title: Associations Between Active Commuting and Sickness Absence in Finnish Public Sector Cohort of 28 485 Employees
pmc-11645541.creator: Essi Kalliolahti, Kia Gluschkoff, Timo Lanki, Jaana I Halonen, Paula Salo, Tuula Oksanen, Jenni Ervasti
pmc-11645541.description: Active commuting can be beneficial for health. We examined whether active commuting by walking or cycling was associated with a lower risk of sickness absence in a Finnish public sector cohort of 28 485 employees. We used negative binomial regression to test associations of weekly active commuting in kilometers (no, low, moderate, and high dose) with all‐cause sickness absence.

pmc-11650099.title: Evaluation of Delirium Risk Factors in Intensive Care Patients
pmc-11650099.creator: Selin Erel, Eda Macit Aydın, Bijen Nazlıel, Lale Karabıyık
pmc-11650099.description: ObjectiveThe negative effects of delirium in intensive care unit (ICU) patients necessitate the identification and management of risk factors. This study aimed to determine the incidence of delirium and its associated modifiable and non-modifiable factors in the ICU setting to provide valuable insights for better patient care and outcomes.MethodsPatients admitted to the ICU underwent delirium screening twice daily.

pmc-12536277.title: What is the point of a base system? Denotation, computation and the non-integers
pmc-12536277.creator: Oisín Parkinson-Coombs, Rafael Núñez
pmc-12536277.description: As researchers and as laypeople, we inhabit worlds replete with numerals, numerals structured by a base system. We rely on exponentiation and powers of the base to describe these systems. This research habit, along with our familiar experience of numerals as expressing precision, produces a conceptual blind spot regarding their development, structure and purpose.

pmc-12845409.title: Efficacy and Safety of Newly Diagnosed Multiple Myeloma Combination Therapies: A Systematic Review Integrating Network Meta-Analysis and Real-World Vigilance Study
pmc-12845409.creator: Yanjun Liu, Ying Zhang, Wenhui Yang, Haoyan Du, Shijie Sun, Zuojing Li, Dongsheng Zong
pmc-12845409.description: Background: Although anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody-based regimens are standard care for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (NDMM), direct comparative efficacy and comprehensive real-world safety data remain scarce. Methods: We conducted a systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis (NMA) of randomized controlled trials (RCTs).

pmc-13335107.title: HNF1B-related disease: developmental origins, molecular mechanisms, and multisystem clinical challenges
pmc-13335107.creator: Petr Heneberg
pmc-13335107.description: Variants or deletions involving the HNF1B gene cause HNF1B-MODY. HNF1B-MODY represents a multisystem disorder extending far beyond its original classification as a monogenic form of diabetes. HNF1B’s role in human development includes critical involvement in the organogenesis of the kidney, pancreas, liver, genitourinary tract, and nervous system.

pmc-13446531.title: Fetoscopic Vesicostomy for Lower Urinary Tract Obstruction: A Proposal for a New Surgical Technique
pmc-13446531.creator: Marcio Lopes Miranda, Kleber Cursino de Andrade, Marcos Caetano, Patricia Traballi Carvalho Pegolo, Renato Ximenes, Rodrigo Ruano
pmc-13446531.description: Key Summary What's already known about this topic?◦Lower urinary tract obstruction (LUTO) is associated with elevated perinatal mortality and morbidity.◦Fetal interventions have been proposed for severe forms of LUTO, including vesicoamniotic shunt placement and fetal cystoscopy.◦Experimental studies suggest that fetal vesicostomy could be a valid therapeutic option especially for fetuses with LUTO associated with Prune Belly.

pmc-13674503.title: Charge-mediated remote epitaxy of Ga2O3 via MoS2
pmc-13674503.creator: Gyeong Ryul Lee, Dong-Gwan Kim, Wonwoo Suh, Yoonho Choi, Donghan Kim, Mohammad M. Afandi, Juhui Oh, Hongsik Park, Celesta S. Chang, Hyun S. Kum, Taehoon Lee, Roy B. Chung
pmc-13674503.description: Remote epitaxy of the corundum phase α-Ga2O3 is demonstrated through a domain-free, transfer-free monolayer of MoS2 template synthesized on sapphire. Despite the intrinsic nonidealities of MoS2—specifically its thickness and polar bonding characteristics—for remote epitaxy, single-crystalline α-Ga2O3 films are epitaxially grown on polycrystalline MoS2 with crystallographic fidelity comparable to those grown directly on bare sapphire.

pmc-13679012.title: Preoperative natremia and AKI after cardiac surgery: an international multicenter prospective cohort study
pmc-13679012.creator: Jose Maria Mora, Pablo Montero-López, Angel Candela, Esther Gómez, David Nagore, Jorge M Núñez-Córdoba, Gemma Echarri, Raquel Callejas, Marc Vives
pmc-13679012.description: Background and goal of studyWhether preoperative natremia levels may play a role in the development of acute kidney injury (AKI) after cardiac surgery is uncertain. We conducted a cohort study to evaluate the influence of preoperative natremia on AKI in high-risk patients undergoing cardiac surgery.

pmc-13696424.title: Fully spin-polarised quantum Hall effect at sub-tesla magnetic fields
pmc-13696424.creator: M Myronov, W Jiang, S Studenikin
pmc-13696424.description: AbstarctThe integer quantum Hall effect provides one of the most precise and robust manifestations of topological quantum transport. Yet, in semiconductor systems, its development to a fully spin-polarised state typically requires magnetic fields of several tesla and milli-Kelvin temperatures to overcome disorder, Landau-level broadening, and thermal smearing.
